newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurostar bars Channel Tunnel bookings until Monday.
newsitem.headline: Eurostar bars Channel Tunnel bookings until Monday.

text.p: Ticket agents for Eurostar trains through the Channel Tunnel said on Wednesday they were refusing bookings until Monday after a fire on a freight shuttle closed the Franco-British link.
"We're not accepting any reservations for any trains before Monday," a booking agent said. "We hope we're erring on the side of caution."
Eurostar would risk complex refunds or re-routings if it sold tickets on the Paris-London and Brussels-London routes for trains that failed to materialise.

Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA Plc said earlier that it hoped an intergovernmental commission overseeing safety would give it the go-ahead to resume services after eight people were hurt by a fire aboard a freight train carrying trucks.
But company sources said hopes of starting up again on Wednesday were dimming.
Passengers who held tickets for cancelled trains on Wednesday were being diverted to ferries or planes.
A spokeswoman for French state railways SNCF, which represents Eurostar in France, said the company was making no forecasts about when traffic would resume.
